description: Answers or files a logged question (question_id from read entity sop_questions), as Handbook > Admin > Questions does: answer, status (open, answered, needs_new_sop, sop_updated, dismissed), sop_id it belongs to, notes. save_as_sop: true has Sergio write the answer into the handbook (the matching article, or a new one). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat does not save it to the handbook twice.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: answer_handbook_question
title: Answer a handbook question
